title: 彭博分析师：内地收紧跨境财富税制，香港保障产品面临压力
speaker: Stephen Engel

segments.en: We are watching, of course, the insurers when markets open in a few minutes, this after the banks and insurers exposed to mainland Chinese wealth flows, we already saw the market reaction in London, following the Thai scene report that Beijing was closing a key tax loophole for Hong Kong insurance policies.
segments.zh: 我们正在关注几分钟后开盘的保障类公司，此前伦敦市场已对相关报道作出反应，报道称内地正在收紧针对香港保障产品的税收漏洞。

segments.en: For more, by joining by our North Asia chief correspondent Stephen Engel and Bloomberg intelligence, Asia Pacific insurance analyst Stephen Lam. Steve, let's start with you. I mean, what do we know so far about the extent of this potential crackdown?
segments.zh: 接下来有请我们的北亚首席记者Stephen Engel和彭博行业研究亚太保障业分析师Stephen Lam。Steve，先从你开始，目前我们对这一潜在收紧措施的范围了解多少？

segments.en: Well, we do know that Beijing has been trying to increase, obviously, its oversight of cross border wealth and also improve tax transparency.
segments.zh: 我们知道，内地一直在加强对跨境财富的监管，并提升税收透明度。

segments.en: You know, and these reports are coming out of Thai scene global, which is fairly independent news organization in China. And they're looking at how the authorities are potentially going to be adding dividends and returns from these tax policies that so many mainland Chinese, when they come to Hong Kong, for example, buy up these policies, and that's been a big source of growth for many banks and also insurance companies.
segments.zh: 这些报道来自泰晤士全球，这是一家相当独立的中国新闻机构。他们关注的是，当局可能如何将这些税收政策下的分红和回报纳入监管，许多内地居民来香港购买这些产品，这已成为许多银行和保障公司的重要增长来源。

segments.en: AIA, potential HSBC, have been increasingly relying on selling these policies. But now, Thai scene global is essentially saying as another step in Beijing's efforts to do what I just said, basically, strengthen oversight of cross border wealth and improve tax transparency, they're going to be adding these returns to individual's personal tax returns and statements and scrutiny.
segments.zh: 友邦、汇丰等越来越依赖销售这些产品。但现在，泰晤士全球表示，作为内地加强跨境财富监管和提升税收透明度努力的一部分，他们将这些回报纳入个人税务申报和审查。

segments.en: Now, again, these kind of returns in the past have been liable to tax by authorities, but it's been very hard to collect that tax, essentially because lack of data transparency or data availability. So, I guess the question to Stephen is going to be, how have they increased that transparency and their ability to enforce that?
segments.zh: 过去这类回报本应缴税，但由于数据不透明或不可得，征税一直很困难。所以，我想问Stephen的是，他们如何提高透明度并加强执行能力？

segments.en: Well, okay, let's put that question to you from Stephen to Stephen. All right, yeah, so the situation is very complex. Let's put it this way. I think it's one of the most, to put things in a perspective, right? This is by far the hardest climb down that I've seen in the at least in the decade. Last time we had something like this was back in 2015, 2016, on the union pay, swiping card, Steve, probably remember about that. So that's actually on the actual money movement side, right?
segments.zh: 好，我们把这个问题从Stephen转到Stephen。是的，情况非常复杂。可以这么说，这是至少十年来我见过的最严厉的收紧措施。上一次类似情况是在2015、2016年关于银联刷卡的限制，Steve可能还记得。那实际上是针对资金流动的。
